items.title: Jim Galloway interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Okay. You probably know Joe Temperley. [INTERVIEWEE] Yes indeed. Oh yes.

ctx.x: Well yeah. I was only there very briefly. I was born there in a nursing home. But my home and where I grew up was a little town four miles from there called Dalry, and that’s where I grew up before I moved into Glasgow when I was a student.
Okay. You probably know Joe Temperley.
